functions.name: is_active_staff
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_active_staff()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.customer_profiles cp
    WHERE cp.user_id = auth.uid()
      AND cp.role IN ('staff', 'admin')
      AND cp.account_status = 'active'
  );
$function$

functions.name: strategy_versions_immutable
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.strategy_versions_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.spec is distinct from old.spec
     or new.spec_hash is distinct from old.spec_hash
     or new.version_no is distinct from old.version_no
     or new.strategy_id is distinct from old.strategy_id
     or new.origin is distinct from old.origin then
    raise exception 'strategy_versions: spec and lineage are immutable';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

functions.name: voom_marketplace_list_strategies_impl
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.voom_marketplace_list_strategies_impl()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, strategy_key text, display_name text, version text, description text, supported_symbols text[], supported_timeframes text[], risk_profile text, lifecycle_status text, trading_mode text, backtest_passed boolean, out_of_sample_passed boolean, demo_passed boolean, risk_review_passed boolean, approved_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
begin
  if v_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'authentication_required' using errcode = '28000';
  end if;
  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.customer_profiles p
    where p.user_id = v_user_id and p.account_status = 'active' and p.role = 'customer'
  ) then
    raise exception 'active_customer_required' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  return query
  select s.id, s.strategy_key, s.display_name, s.version, s.description,
         s.supported_symbols, s.supported_timeframes, s.risk_profile,
         s.lifecycle_status, s.trading_mode, s.backtest_passed,
         s.out_of_sample_passed, s.demo_passed, s.risk_review_passed, s.approved_at
  from public.ai_strategies s
  where s.lifecycle_status = 'approved'
    and s.trading_mode in ('paper','demo')
    and s.backtest_passed and s.out_of_sample_passed
    and s.demo_passed and s.risk_review_passed
  order by s.updated_at desc
  limit 100;
end;
$function$

functions.name: cleanup_expired_alpaca_oauth_states
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cleanup_expired_alpaca_oauth_states()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  delete from public.alpaca_oauth_states where expires_at <= now();
$function$

functions.name: consume_alpaca_oauth_state
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.consume_alpaca_oauth_state(p_state_hash text)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  return query
    delete from public.alpaca_oauth_states s
    where s.state_hash = p_state_hash and s.expires_at > now()
    returning s.user_id;
end;
$function$

functions.name: voom_handle_new_auth_user
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.voom_handle_new_auth_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.customer_profiles (user_id, display_name, account_status, role)
  values (
    new.id,
    nullif(trim(coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'display_name', '')), ''),
    'active',
    'customer'
  )
  on conflict (user_id) do nothing;
  return new;
end;
$function$
